details:
I know I can't be the only one who has seen an uptick in AI generated content used in recent worlds on VRChat, specifically when it comes to pictures, art, or textures. I feel that this will only get worse because there is now Discord servers and websites that also let you generate 3D content using AI. 

I've already seen so many worlds use AI art and hang it on walls which is often disturbing and uncanny looking. I recommend adding a way for world creators to disclose this by ticking a box when uploading a world that lets players know if the game contains AI or not for full transparency.
title: Disclose AI Generated Content in Worlds
